meta.title: Product — Dispatch, route planning and work-time
meta.description: PTS in detail: dispatch board, multi-stop route optimization, BAG-compliant work-time, offline driver app. For chauffeur, taxi and medical transport fleets.

hero.h1: Two jobs. One system. No more Excel.
hero.sub: PTS does two things very well: plan routes & dispatch, and track work time to German labor law. Everything else we deliberately left out.

disposition.h2: Trips, vehicles and drivers — on one board.
disposition.body: The PTS board shows every shift on a timeline. Every trip is a colored block, every vehicle a row. Conflicts get flagged before you assign — double-bookings are impossible.

cards.title: Drag & drop
cards.body: Assign trips by dragging. The driver receives push notification and route instantly.

cards.title: Recurring trips
cards.body: School runs, dialysis shuttles, business pickup series: set up once, run for months.

cards.title: Conflict detection
cards.body: Overlapping times, missing breaks, expired licenses — PTS warns immediately.

routen.h2: Multi-stop routes. Live traffic. No manual re-planning.
routen.body: PTS optimizes routes for single trips and whole shifts. On delay the system re-plans automatically — the driver gets the new route, the passenger gets an ETA update.
list: Multi-stop with time windows and priorities
Live traffic HERE + OSM, ETA to the minute
Automatic re-plan on jam or cancellation
Kilometer and time report per order

fahrerApp.body: The PTS driver app shows the next order with one-tap navigation, customer data and work-time tracking. All offline-ready — in tunnels, parking garages, rural areas.
list: iOS and Android, native, 2 MB update size
One-tap status: Arrived · Passenger onboard · Destination reached
Payment via SumUp, Zettle or barcode scan
Languages: DE, EN, TR, PL, AR

arbeitszeit.h2: BAG ruling 2022 met. Without extra software.
arbeitszeit.body: On 13 Sep 2022 the German Federal Labor Court made complete work-time recording mandatory for all employees. PTS meets that requirement — for your drivers, your dispatchers, your workshop staff.
list: Per-driver, per-day recording with start, end and breaks
Approval workflow: driver confirms, dispatcher signs off, versioned
Tamper-evident storage with full change log
Export as PDF or straight to DATEV payroll

onboarding.h2: Productive in 5 business days. No IT project.
onboarding.body: You don't need a project lead, consultants or a six-month rollout. PTS is simple enough that your team on day five works as if they'd never used anything else.

steps.name: Kickoff
steps.text: 60-minute call: master data check, goals, points of contact. You get PTS tenant access and a data migration checklist.

steps.name: Import
steps.text: We migrate drivers, vehicles, customers and current trips from Excel, CSV or your previous software. You review in sandbox mode.

steps.name: Training
steps.text: Two 90-minute sessions: dispatch for back office, driver app for drivers. Recording and handout remain available.

steps.name: Test trips
steps.text: 3–5 real trips run through PTS with us on chat, fixing configuration on the fly.

steps.name: Go-live
steps.text: Productive use. Support on standby, response time under 4 minutes. Excel and paper go to the basement.

segments.h2: One product. Three segments. Each considered in detail.

cards.title: Chauffeur & private hire
cards.body: For limousine services, business chauffeurs and hotel transfers. Return-to-base proofs per § 49 PBefG automatic, corporate clients on framework agreements, invoices with cost-center split.

cards.title: Taxi
cards.body: For licensed taxi operators. Integrations with taxameter, TX-App and ISI-Fahrbetrieb. VAT split correctly, cash reconciliation clean, records one click away.

cards.title: Medical & school transport
cards.body: For qualified medical transport and regular school routes. Health-fund billing, recurring trips, passenger master data with GDPR-compliant encryption.

integrations.h2: Works with the systems you already use.

cta.h2: Show us your fleet. We'll show you PTS.
cta.body: 30 minutes, no commitment. Afterwards you know whether PTS fits.
